body.message:
Thank you for your message and for considering a longer-term commitment.

For the rates we have shared above, the total for the 6-month period is AED 74,500. If you would prefer a fixed monthly rate, we can offer this as AED 12,416.66 per month for 6 months.

This fixed rate can be secured for the 6-month period only. After the confirmed 6-month period, any further extension or renewal would be subject to the rates and availability applicable at that time.

Please note that this is the fixed-rate option we are able to offer based on the current quotation.

Thank you, and please let us know if this option works for you.
